h1: Eco-Friendly Painting Options for Environmentally Conscious Homeowners in Kirkland

nodes.text: People are going green across the country — and none more so than in Washington. In Kirkland, specifically, there’s been a greater push for everything eco-friendly. As a Kirkland homeowner, you can join the movement by making environmentally conscious choices like in the paint you use.

nodes.text: Eco-friendly paints are excellent alternatives when you want to transform your home and reduce your carbon footprint at the same time. You’ll also experience fewer health risks with paints made from sustainable materials instead of synthetic and potentially toxic ones.

nodes.text: Understanding VOCs and Their Impact
If you’ve been shopping around for paints, there’s a chance you’ve heard of VOCs. However, what does “VOC” actually mean?
nodes.html: If you’ve been shopping around for paints, there’s a chance you’ve heard of VOCs. However, what does “VOC” actually mean?

nodes.text: According to the EPA, VOCs (or volatile organic compounds) are a major ingredient in many paints. When paint dries, these chemicals evaporate into the air in a process called off-gassing.
nodes.html: According to the EPA, VOCs (or volatile organic compounds) are a major ingredient in many paints. When paint dries, these chemicals evaporate into the air in a process called off-gassing.

nodes.text: Why does this matter?
nodes.html: Why does this matter?

nodes.text: High-VOC are toxic, so they can cause headaches, dizziness, or worse symptoms. Over time, exposure to VOCs may lead to more severe health issues like respiratory problems or even liver and kidney damage. Let’s also not forget how toxic VOCs can be to the environment.

nodes.text: The Benefits of Eco-Friendly Paints
Eco-friendly paints bring a host of advantages that go beyond just being “green.”
nodes.html: Eco-friendly paints bring a host of advantages that go beyond just being “green.”

nodes.text: First, they dramatically improve indoor air quality. Without high levels of VOCs, you won’t be exposed to toxins for days or weeks after a fresh paint job. The positive environmental impact your choice makes is also a win. These paints are made using fewer harmful chemicals, so they’re better for the planet.

nodes.text: There are also health benefits for your home and family. If you’ve got little ones crawling around or furry friends who love to sniff everything, low-VOC eco-friendly paints are the way to go.

nodes.text: You don’t have to compromise on quality, either, as low or no-VOC paints are excellent alternatives to their more toxic counterparts. Eco-friendly paints can hold their own against traditional paints, especially in terms of durability and adhesion.

nodes.text: Types of Eco-Friendly Paints
There are several kinds of eco-friendly paints to choose from, and each offers unique benefits for you and your Kirkland home.
nodes.html: There are several kinds of eco-friendly paints to choose from, and each offers unique benefits for you and your Kirkland home.

nodes.text: Low-VOC or Zero-VOC Paints
Low-VOC and zero-VOC paints are some of the most popular options. Low-VOC paints contain fewer chemicals, while zero-VOC paints eliminate them almost entirely.
nodes.html: Low-VOC and zero-VOC paints are some of the most popular options. Low-VOC paints contain fewer chemicals, while zero-VOC paints eliminate them almost entirely.

nodes.text: Natural and Plant-Based Paints

If you’re serious about taking your green homeownership a step further, you can also opt for natural or plant-based paints. These eco-friendly paints consist of organic substances and materials, including clay, oil, lime, or even milk proteins.

nodes.text: Recycled Paints
Why not try recycled paints?

nodes.text: Also known as reprocessed or blended paints, these are made by taking leftover paints, reconditioning them, and making them ready for use for any home project.

nodes.text: Sustainable Painting Practices
Selecting eco-friendly paints is just one part of the equation — how you apply them matters just as much.
nodes.html: Selecting eco-friendly paints is just one part of the equation — how you apply them matters just as much.

nodes.text: Prepare Your Surfaces

Let’s kick off the list of best eco-friendly practices with preparation. Clean and prime your walls, so the paint adheres properly and lasts longer. When you do this, there will be no need for frequent and wasteful repaints.
nodes.html: Let’s kick off the list of best eco-friendly practices with preparation. Clean and prime your walls, so the paint adheres properly and lasts longer. When you do this, there will be no need for frequent and wasteful repaints.

nodes.text: Think “Big and Broad” When Applying Paints

Your paint application techniques also need to be efficient. Ditch smaller brushes. Efficient application techniques like using the right brushes and rollers can help you save paint while providing even coverage.
nodes.html: Your paint application techniques also need to be efficient. Ditch smaller brushes. Efficient application techniques like using the right brushes and rollers can help you save paint while providing even coverage.

nodes.text: Dispose Properly… But Recycle When Able
Lastly, don’t forget about proper disposal. When disposing of paints and painting materials, recycle whatever can be reused. Recycling can help you save massively on future costs.

nodes.text: Choosing the Right Eco-Friendly Paints
Not every paint will give you the results you want.

nodes.text: When choosing between paints, factor in durability, color options, and certifications. As for certifications, there are many labels, but you can’t go wrong with paints that bear the GreenGuard or Green Seal logos.

nodes.text: Most importantly, think of the Pacific Northwest’s unique climate conditions. Eco-friendly paints that resist moisture and mildew are your best bet, especially if you’re painting your exteriors.
